guesthouseInfo.locationDetails: We host two cosy apartments in the heart of Pogradec—close to shops, a market, and the Orthodox church. They're only about a five-minute walk apart, so friends or family can stay near each other yet enjoy their own space. The lake is just two to three minutes away on foot: easy for a morning dip, an evening stroll, or simply watching the water from town. Downtown, the beach, and the bus station are still only a short walk away. Whether you're planning a quick getaway or a longer stay—from a couple of nights up to around three months—you'll have a friendly base to explore from day one.
guesthouseInfo.facilitiesTitle: What you'll find in each apartment
guesthouseInfo.facilitiesDetails: Every apartment is set up for easy, comfortable living: a well-equipped kitchen, air-conditioned living and sleeping space, a quality TV, reliable Wi-Fi, and a bathroom with a washing machine. You'll have fresh towels, a west-facing balcony for golden-hour sunsets, and bright windows that make the place feel open and calm—ideal for anything from a weekend to several weeks away from home.
guesthouseInfo.preferedVisitorsDetails: Prima Apartments is a warm, open-minded home for couples, families, solo travellers, and friends from all walks of life. Many guests come for a short break; others settle in for weeks—or even a few months—when they want to really unwind by the lake and get to know Pogradec. In winter, our light-filled apartments are especially inviting if you're after a peaceful escape from the cold.

houseRules.ruleReservations: From 2 nights up to about 3 months. Ask us about better rates for stays of 6+ nights.
houseRules.rule1: Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 11:00. Arrival and departure are contactless.
houseRules.rule3: Pay by bank (BKT), PayPal, or cash—we’ll confirm when you book.
